# fde — a framework for Forward Deployed Engineers

> fde is an open-source Python framework that takes a client AI engagement
> from a problem statement to a runnable, deployable project: structured
> discovery intake with provenance, a deterministic decision engine that
> cites evidence and names rejected alternatives, and code generation that
> emits a working project with an evaluation harness, deployment assets,
> an operations runbook, and a risk page. It supports on-premise,
> customer-VPC and air-gapped deployment, and never calls an LLM itself —
> the same profile always produces the same project.

Key facts:

- Intake surfaces: free-flow prose, documents (PDF/docx), sample
  input/output pairs, a role-scoped interview (sponsor, eval owner, user,
  admin, skeptic — optionally one scope axis at a time via --scope:
  functional, non-functional, data, environment, operational, commercial),
  and a hardware scan. All emit Facts into one Profile.
- Provenance ordering is dimension-dependent: measurements outrank
  statements about the environment; stated requirements outrank
  measurements. Two respondents disagreeing is reported as a finding, not
  silently resolved.
- Six gates precede building: verified data access (hard — cannot be
  waived), a re-measurable baseline, a named evaluation owner, scope drift
  measured against the original statement, offline evaluability for
  air-gapped systems, and licence compatibility against what the client
  intends to ship. Waivers are recorded with reasons and shipped in the
  generated RISKS.md.
- Hosting topologies: public-saas, managed-api, customer-vpc, hybrid,
  on-prem, air-gapped. Hybrid is first-class: sensitive work pinned
  inside, burst outside, the boundary between them enforced in the
  emitted code. The generated ARCHITECTURE.md carries a scope read-out
  by axis, a tools-and-libraries table with in-topology alternatives,
  and an agent-and-tool posture section.
- The knowledge registry (framework/) is data, not code: dimensions,
  approaches, patterns, stacks, interfaces, templates, cases, and locale
  packs (jurisdiction presets and dated obligations that can never change
  how decisions are made). Patterns are
  stable; stacks churn; swapping a stack changes emitted code, not the
  architecture.
- Decisions are simplest-first with cited evidence; undecidable components
  ship as modules that raise with the reason attached. `fde kb sweep`
  reports profile shapes no approach can serve.
- Self-evolution is capture-first: overrides, trigger calibration and
  anonymised cases are recorded per engagement; cases enter the corpus only
  after human sanitisation review; rules are revised only against a corpus
  of outcomes.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/atulkapoor/fde-framework/blob/main/README.md):
  what it is, who it is for, install, quickstart, FAQ
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/atulkapoor/fde-framework/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  the contribution contract; client material never enters the repository
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/atulkapoor/fde-framework/blob/main/SECURITY.md):
  reporting vulnerabilities; the sanitisation model

## Key source

- [framework/](https://github.com/atulkapoor/fde-framework/tree/main/framework):
  the knowledge registry — every entry is markdown with YAML front matter
  and a prose rationale
- [src/fde/](https://github.com/atulkapoor/fde-framework/tree/main/src/fde):
  intake, gates, decision engine, architect, emitter, deploy/ops
  generation, evolution capture
